<!-- pr-reviewer: 49ec197f169adc9e04c4d5baf7d33f9f04a0e668 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** I found no blockers. There is one Carvera ATC question below that the maintainer should decide before merging, since this is posted motion.

### What looks good
- The three posts share one small change (`traverseZ` / `xyFirst`). The height is `max(ClearancePlane else RetractPlane, move's own Z)`, written in work coordinates through `wo(..., orgZ)` like every other Z word. Planes reset at `onSectionEnd`, so a section never inherits the previous one's height.
- The refusal is a counted `message()`. `posting.rs:588` turns any warning into "post blocked", so the bare `G0 X Y Z` that grblHAL and Carvera still write after the refusal never reaches a file. TinyG returns `false` from `startXY`.
- It cannot misfire on a real job: `post::dump` (`crates/post/src/post/mod.rs:260-261`) states both planes on every section. Of the 40 tracked `.cnc` fixtures, only `recorded/inputs/inverted_probe.cnc` states neither plane, and it is not a grblHAL, TinyG or Carvera stream.
- The `crates/app/tests/common/legacy_program.rs` hunk is identical to #1618's, checked by diffing the two PRs. #1618's head also merges cleanly on top of this PR's trial merge.
- `tormach.cps` is untouched. There are no process files, so no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump is needed. No `build.rs`, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes, and no snapshot PNGs. The decision file and `Changelog:` line are present, and the new suite carries its provenance and gate map.

### Golden diff (scripted, trial merge vs `upstream/main`)
- **58 changed `.nc` files, 61 added lines, 0 removed or changed lines.** Every added line matches `^G0 Z<n>$` and sits directly before a bare `G0 X.. Y..`. The body says 57 files; the list it gives adds up to 58.
- **Coverage:** I checked all 61 grblHAL, TinyG and Carvera goldens at the merged head. For every program start or `M6`, the first X/Y move must be a bare `G0 X Y` preceded directly by `G0 Z`. That gives 61 anchors and **0 lacking**. The three `empty_section.nc` goldens have no X/Y move and are correctly unchanged.

### Local results (merged with main, macOS, debug)
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-post`: all 51 test binaries, including the new `first_traverse_clearance` (5 tests) | 469 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app`: altmill_machines 4, conformance 7, control_comp 5, post_cycle_feed_spindle 8, program_units 7, tinyg_post 18, tormach_post 10, tormach_machines 6, tormach_end_units 7, wear_comp 5, after_op 10, carvera_post 4, carvera_machines 1, coolant_air 4, grblhal_post 9, makera_z1 4, mcp_units 2, post_spindle_rule_all 5, probe_no_coolant 5, smoothing 7, golden_cl 33, recorded_post_streams 5, posting 17, per_op_files 9, tormach_toolchange_lift 3, program_entry 9, solid_law_goldens 7 | 211 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` | clean |

The full quick-tier app list (about 400 suites, 837 s in the author's run) was not re-run. The suites above are the ones that post through these dialects or read the shared golden input.

**Mutation checks** (each post mutated on its own, then restored; 15 runs, **all red**):
| Mutation | grblHAL | TinyG | Carvera |
|---|---|---|---|
| drop the `G0 Z` lift | red (4/5 + 2 others) | red (4/5 + 2) | red (4/5 + 1) |
| lift written after the X/Y traverse | red (4/5 + 2) | red (4/5 + 2) | red (4/5 + 1) |
| move's own Z used instead of the plane | red (3/5 + 2) | red (3/5 + 3) | red (3/5) |
| lift only at program start, skipped after a tool change | red (2/5 + 2) | red (2/5 + 2) | red (2/5 + 1) |
| refusal skipped (bare X/Y traverse at unknown height) | red (refusal test + 1) | red (refusal test + 1) | red (refusal test) |

### Requested before merge
None blocking.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. **Carvera ATC: a Z-only descent at the changer's X/Y. Maintainer decision, please.** `carvera.cps` itself says "the changer moved X and Y" (`xyUnknown = true` beside `M6 T..`). Before this PR the first move after `M6` was X/Y at the changer-raised height, then Z down over the part. Now it is `G0 Z<work clearance>` first, at wherever the ATC left the spindle (rack or tool-length sensor area), and only then X/Y. When the clearance is below the changer's exit height, that is a new downward rapid at the rack's X/Y. With a thin stock on the bed, work Z5 can sit lower than the tops of tools stored in the rack. Nothing in the repo documents where Carvera firmware leaves X/Y after `M6`, and the PR ran no hardware. On grblHAL and TinyG the change point is the operator's or the last operation's X/Y, so I see no equivalent risk there.
   - The PR's choice still guards the #1614 case: a tip below the clearance at top of travel hits the Z soft limit instead of crossing the part.
   - Options: (a) accept it as is; (b) confirm from the Carvera manual that the firmware returns the spindle to a clear X/Y, or to its pre-change X/Y, and say so in the post comment; (c) for Carvera only, keep X/Y first, because its firmware measures tool length itself and parks at machine top.
2. **`Fixes` vs `Refs`.** The body says "This PR therefore says `Refs #1616`" and the commit trailer is `Refs #1616`, but the body ends `Fixes #1616`. The decision file also says the Fanuc PR closes #1616. With the Fanuc half now tracked in #1633, `Fixes` is fine, but please make the body sentence and `docs/decisions/1616-first-traverse-clearance.md` agree with whichever you keep.
3. **Stale comment:** `assets/posts/carvera.cps:322-326` still says the first move "positions X Y alone at the current (changer-raised) height, and only then does Z come down". The new #1616 block right below it contradicts that. `grblhal.cps:407-412` and `tinyg.cps:436-440` have similar "safe, Z-up height" wording. Worth a one-line touch-up.
4. **Z height and work offsets:** `ClearancePlane` is model-absolute and is written relative to the setup's origin (`wo(.., orgZ)`). It therefore stays the user's CAM clearance above the part wherever the work zero sits, as long as the physical offset matches the CAM setup. I think that is acceptable for these controls, which have no G53 tool-change-height convention like the Tormach.
5. **Spindle and length offset:** the lift comes after `M3` and coolant, and after `M6`. Carvera applies its measured tool length inside `M6`, and grblHAL and TinyG use no G43 here, so the lift always runs with the right length in effect.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: a1833e52965a80c9f89b610fc5af8f5d692a6939 -->
**Review of a1833e52: needs two wording changes before merge. No safety blocker found.**

**What looks good**
- Carvera after `M6`: `changedAt` is set where `M6` is written (carvera.cps:289). `xyFirst` then writes the bare `G0 X Y`, then `G0 Z<clearance>`, and only then the combined rapid or the StartZ rapid. No descent precedes the Z line on any path that reaches `xyFirst`; Carvera cycles arrive as plain moves. With no tool change at program start, Z comes first (new test pins it).
- grblHAL and TinyG: this delta is comments only (every hunk read); their goldens did not move.
- Goldens, read by diff: 58 .nc files in the PR (the body says 57), only added `G0 Z` lines, nothing removed. The delta adds 20 pure swaps of the `G0 Z<n>` line and the bare X/Y line in 19 Carvera files (read two_tool_pocket, extreme_coords, drill_retract, drill_peck line by line).
- The first review's checks hold: Z written before the first X/Y after each tool change on grblHAL and TinyG, planes read per section and reset at section end, height never below the move's own Z, work offset and inch units right (altmill inch Z0.5906 = 15 mm), the same-height skip is safe, the real generator always states both planes (post/mod.rs:260-261) so no app program is newly refused. The no-plane refusal blocks the post through the callers' warnings check (posting.rs:588 and the mount, per-op, wire paths). The `legacy_program.rs` hunk is identical to PR 1618's.
- Laws: post scripts exempt from the 400-line guide; the new test is in crates/post/tests and imports only camcraft_post; decision file present; Changelog line present; nothing from a vendor.

**Results (merged with main, on the self-hosted runner)**
- Run 43566199345: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43566199345 - success. Quick gate: post suites ok (31 s), app suites ok (903 s), 0 failed; clippy on the touched crates clean.
- The earlier run 43564558512 on the same head failed only on the issue 1605 flake (`a_lowered_cap_refuses_the_same_face_at_once`, import_step_guard.rs:36), unrelated to this diff.
- Not run: the author's mutation checks; no Windows-only readings in the diff.

**Requested before merge**
1. The Carvera claim is overstated. The body says each post "now states that height", and the decision file and the `carvera.cps` comment (around line 330) say the new hazard is not added. After `M6` the Carvera still rapids bare X/Y at the changer's exit height, which is the issue 1614 hazard (tip below the part top there), taken on trust because nothing read says where the firmware parks the spindle. Say that plainly in the body, the decision file and the comment: the hazard stays for the Carvera after `M6` until the exit position is confirmed (option b). Also add to "Not exercised" that the Carvera firmware's `M6` exit position was not read.
2. The closing keyword for issue 1616 closes it, but issue 1616's "Done means" is every spindle mill post stating Z before its first X/Y after a tool change. The Fanuc family (issue 1633) and the Carvera after `M6` are outside that. Either keep the keyword out (`Refs`) or narrow issue 1616 and move those two remainders into open issues before it closes.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Unchanged since the first review: after the no-plane refusal the combined `G0 X.. Y.. Z..` is still written (`xyFirst` returns, `onRapid` still posts it), and the refusal test (first_traverse_clearance.rs) still only asserts that the exact line `G0 X20 Y10` is absent. Only the callers' warnings check blocks the post. A stronger assertion, or stopping the move, would close it.
- A work-offset change without a tool change does not re-arm `xyUnknown`; unchanged by this PR.
- After `M6`, a stream rapid with Z only (no X/Y) is still written at an unknown X/Y on the Carvera; pre-existing.
- The Z-only rapid after a tool change can be downward at the unknown X/Y on grblHAL and TinyG (the same as the Tormach post in PR 1618).
- The `merge-ready` label and the "delta re-review clean" comment come from the author's own account; they are not a review and I did not rely on them.

**Label:** this PR carries `merge-ready` from one collaborator and now a collaborator review asking for changes. AGENTS.md calls that a disagreement for the two collaborators to settle on the PR, so I left the label as set. It is not to be merged by us until the two points above are answered.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
